mechanism: Clarithromycin inhibits CYP3A4, potentially increasing enalapril's active metabolite (enalaprilat) levels and enhancing ACE inhibitor effects; clarithromycin may also impair renal function, reducing ACE inhibitor clearance.
action: Monitor blood pressure and renal function; adjust enalapril dose if significant hypotension or hyperkalemia develops; consider alternative antibiotic with lower CYP3A4 interaction potential if possible.
